themes.description: Suggestions for new features, enhancements, or improvements to existing functionality within the application.
This theme covers feedback related to the app's design, ease of use, available features, and overall user experience.
This theme covers feedback related to the experience, functionality, or availability of specific investment products like IPOs, mutual funds, or stocks.
Reviews expressing satisfaction with the service, app, or overall experience.
Complaints about the app's complexity, difficulty of use, or unclear interface and features.
This theme covers problems related to referral programs, including unreceived rewards, lack of transparency, or issues with the referral system.
This theme covers issues related to how trades are executed, including auto-square-off, order matching, and unexpected outcomes from trading actions.
This theme covers requests or complaints about specific trading functionalities, tools, or missing features within the platform.
Covers requests for new features, improvements to existing features, and general user experience enhancements.
Requests for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or improvements to the application's user interface and navigation.
Reviews that provide overall positive or negative feedback about the application's general usability and user experience without specific issues.
This theme covers general positive or negative feedback about the overall application experience, trustworthiness, or user satisfaction that doesn't fit specific functional categories.

This theme covers feedback, complaints, or suggestions related to the range, display, or quality of investment products and options available on the platform, including mutual funds, stocks, or other assets.
Addresses issues with downloading, installing, or accessing the application from app stores or specific devices.
Concerns or inquiries about the availability of specific investment products, services, or markets within the app.
Issues related to account balances, unexpected charges, and the management of specific account features or financial products.
Issues related to order execution, market manipulation, and the overall fairness and reliability of the trading platform.
Issues related to order placement, execution prices, and discrepancies in buy/sell rates.
Covers complaints about limitations or rules imposed on trading activities, such as stop-loss restrictions or order type limitations.
This theme covers concerns related to the platform's trustworthiness, data security, ethical practices, and overall reliability.
This theme covers feedback related to the application's user interface, user experience, design, layout, and the presence or absence of specific features.
Concerns related to the application's consumption of device resources, such as storage space or memory.
This theme covers complaints related to the application's design, navigation, workflow, and overall ease of use.
